class gen_coap_service.setup.dependencies.GenCoAPServiceBundleDependencies[source]¶

Bases: TypedDict

GenCoAPService bundle dependencies for the gen_coap_service bundle.

It defines:

attributes:
base - The base bundle with the base components for the gen_coap_service bundle.
service - The service orchestrating the gen_coap_service’s execution for the gen_coap_service bundle.
subprocessor - The adapter executing the gen_coap_service’s sub-processes for the gen_coap_service bundle.
cli - The command-line interface adapter for the gen_coap_service bundle.
